causes.label: The power supply has been disconnected.
remedies: Check whether the lighting in your kitchen or other appliances in the room are working.
causes.evidence: Bosch manual, page 24: "The power supply has been disconnected."

causes.label: The appliance has not been connected as shown in the circuit diagram.
remedies: Disconnect the appliance from the power supply.
Make sure the appliance has been connected as shown in the circuit diagram.
causes.evidence: Bosch manual, page 24: "The appliance has not been connected as shown in the circuit diagram."

causes.label: There is an electronics fault
remedies: If the fault cannot be eliminated, call Customer Service.
causes.evidence: Bosch manual, page 24: "There is an electronics fault"

causes.label: The control panel is wet or objects are lying on it.
remedies: Dry the control panel or remove the object.
causes.evidence: Bosch manual, page 24: "The control panel is wet or objects are lying on it."

symptoms.symptom: is flashing in the cooking zone displays.

causes.label: There is an electronics fault
remedies: Briefly cover the control panel with your hand to acknowledge the fault.
causes.evidence: Bosch manual, page 24: "There is an electronics fault"

causes.label: The electronics have overheated. The corresponding cooking zone has switched off.
remedies: Wait until the electronics have cooled down sufficiently.
Touch any control element.
When error message disappears, the electronics have cooled down sufficiently.
You can continue to cook.
causes.evidence: Bosch manual, page 24: "The electronics have overheated. The corresponding cooking zone has switched off."

causes.label: The electronics have overheated. All cooking zones have switched off.
remedies: Wait until the electronics have cooled down sufficiently.
Touch any control element.
When error message disappears, the electronics have cooled down sufficiently.
You can continue to cook.
causes.evidence: Bosch manual, page 24: "The electronics have overheated. All cooking zones have switched off."

causes.label: There is hot cookware near the control panel. The cooking zone has switched off to protect the electronics.
remedies: Remove the cookware from the control panel.
Wait a few seconds.
Touch any control element.
When error message disappears, the electronics have cooled down sufficiently.
You can continue to cook.
causes.evidence: Bosch manual, page 25: "There is hot cookware near the control panel. The cooking zone has switched off to protect the electronics."

causes.label: The cooking zone has been operating continuously for an extended period of time without interaction. The automatic time limitation has been triggered.
remedies: Touch any control element.
You can set the cooking zone and continue to cook.
causes.evidence: Bosch manual, page 25: "The cooking zone has been operating continuously for an extended period of time without interaction. The automatic time limitation has been triggered."

causes.label: The supply voltage is incorrect. It is outside the normal operating range.
remedies: Contact your electrical utility provider.
causes.evidence: Bosch manual, page 25: "The supply voltage is incorrect. It is outside the normal operating range."

causes.label: The cooktop is unable to connect to your home network or to the hood.
remedies: Switch the appliance off and on again.
If the fault was a one-off occurrence, the message disappears.
If the message appears again, call Customer Service. Please specify the exact
error message when calling.
causes.evidence: Bosch manual, page 25: "The cooktop is unable to connect to your home network or to the hood."

symptoms.symptom: and cooking zones do not heat up

causes.label: Demo mode is activated.
remedies: Disconnect the appliance from the power supply for 30 seconds by switching
off the circuit breaker or fuse in the electrical panel.
Touch any touch field within the next 3 minutes.
causes.evidence: Bosch manual, page 25: "Demo mode is activated."
